findings.text: blocking: the scope paragraph states 'Two accepted names' documentation was brought in line', which this document's own title (line 8), H1 (lines 12-15) and 'What is left' section (line 156) contradict: radial_coordinate_at_outboard_midplane was stopped below threshold and left at docs_stage=drafted with an unreviewed chain-2 regeneration, so the landed fragment asserts an outcome the node did not reach.

follow-on: the fragment and manifest report name 2's review round as 0.562, but the node's own record computes that round's mean as 0.516667 at shc-midplane-docs-refresh.json:117 (0.425, 0.5625, 0.5625), so the cited score cannot be reconciled against the record the fragment points a reader to; the below-threshold conclusion is unaffected.

follow-on: _graph_comments() is defined and never called - report() uses comments() reading the captured logs/reviewer-comments.json - and it duplicates docs-axis reviewer-feedback reads the repository already owns at imas_codex/standard_names/graph_ops.py:2586 and 2477.

follow-on: BEFORE[...]['names_midplane_identifier'] is hardcoded True while the read-back's empty midplane search is reported with no positive control showing the regex fires; the fragment's read-back prose at shc-midplane-docs-refresh.html:132-134 also claims a 'dd:' path is searched, a token MIDPLANE_IDENTIFIER_RE/DD_FIELD_RE do not contain.

follow-on: main() returns 0 for the report mode unconditionally, so the node's declared gate cannot distinguish a met measure from an unmet one and logs/node-gate.log reads EXIT=0 for a run whose second name scored null.

VERDICT done_when: the done_when names the node's JSON record and runner; docs/evidence/fragments/sn-harmonize-command/shc-midplane-docs-refresh-run.py:472-486 report() assembles locus check, route/invocations, before, after, read_checks, reviewer_comments and spend, and the manifest's tests: line is that report command; logs/node-gate.log ends a real EXIT=0. The gate records every done_when item but never asserts any of them.

Its tests: line is a literal re-runnable command; its baseline_suite and after_suite are 'none: ...' because the write paths hold no test file, so added_failure_count=0 with no ids to derive.
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit against 96aab3e62 — a single commit f43739c65 adds shc-midplane-docs-refresh-run.py (511 lines, the runner), shc-midplane-docs-refresh.html (169 lines, the landing fragment) and shc-midplane-docs-refresh.json (513 lines, the record); the runner performs no graph write and the fragment carries node-prefixed element ids.
